name: Ezra
source:
"Do you intend to rebel against fate, Temptress?"

Ezra, the warrior priest who literally sweeps you off your feet. This charming and cunning man is a mystery to behold, yet you cannot deny the chemistry that you have with him. Will you be able to resist his allure, or will you fall into the arms of a “man of Marris”.

He carries your mark over his heart, but can you breach its deep labyrinth and find the truth behind his secretive existence? Why does his warmth feel so fleeting? Why does he always feel just out of reach?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eternallovestudios/shattered-souls-a-dark-fantasy-isekai-otome]Kickstarter[/url]]
